description:
Add both style and function to your nursery with the Newport Nightstand. Crafted from solid Brown Maple hardwood, this compact nightstand provides the perfect spot for a lamp, a book, or a glass of water beside the glider.

Drawer storage keeps pacifiers, burp cloths, and other essentials organized and close at hand.
